verdict.rationale: Riskified documents a pre-authorization synchronous integration type in which the `/decide` and `/advise` endpoints of its REST API return a fraud decision synchronously, with CVV/3DS and TRA/SCA recommendations, before payment authorization. The response is framed as an approve/decline decision rather than an explicit numeric risk score, and the machine-learning basis appears only implicitly (models are calibrated during onboarding). Missing for 10: an explicit numeric risk score field, documented latency or real-time performance figures, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
